from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DilutedEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single Diluted Earnings Per Share data point found in a document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the financial statement belongs to")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the EPS figure represents (e.g. '2020')")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label found in the document (e.g. 'Diluted EPS')")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric Diluted EPS amount reported for the fiscal year")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the data point in the text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    diluted_eps_records: list[DilutedEPSRecord]
